en: Vostok 6 carried Valentina Tereshkova, and made her the first woman in space — a fact that stood alone for nineteen years and went unmatched by the United States until 1983. She was not a pilot but a textile worker and amateur parachutist, chosen in part for exactly that symbolism: proof, the Soviet program said, that in the workers' state even the frontier of space was open to anyone. Whatever the motive, forty-eight orbits later the milestone was real and permanent, and it would be two decades before any other nation could say it had done the same.
cur: Vostok 6搭载了瓦莲京娜·捷列什科娃，使她成为首位太空女性——这个纪录独占鳌头达十九年之久，直到1983年才被美国打破。她并非飞行员，而是纺织工人和业余跳伞运动员，她的选中部分源于这种象征意义：苏联航天计划宣传称，在工人阶级国家，即使太空边疆也向所有人敞开大门。无论初衷如何，四十八圈轨道飞行后，这一里程碑成为永远的现实，又过了二十年后，才有其他国家能够宣布自己做到了同样的事。

en: Valentina Tereshkova's 48-orbit, 2-day-23-hour flight — the first woman in space, and still the only woman ever to have flown a solo space mission. Selected from a group of five female cosmonaut candidates assembled in 1962, Tereshkova launched 1963-06-16 09:30 UTC, only 2 years after Gagarin's first orbital flight. Her capsule programmed for an upward-rather-than-downward orbit-correction burn — she manually identified the error and ground controllers re-uploaded corrected attitude software the next day. Landed 1963-06-19 08:20 UTC near Bayevo, Altai Krai. Tereshkova later became a senior figure in Soviet politics and remains the youngest woman ever flown to orbit at 26 years.
cur: 瓦莲京娜·捷列什科娃的48圈、历时2天23小时的飞行——首位太空女性，也是迄今唯一执行过单人太空任务的女性。捷列什科娃从1962年组建的五名女宇航员候选人中选出，于1963年06月16日09:30 UTC发射，仅比加加林首次轨道飞行晚两年。她的太空舱预装的轨道修正程序设定为上升而非下降——她手动识别出这一错误，地面控制人员在次日重新上传了修正后的姿态软件。于1963年06月19日08:20 UTC在Bayevo、Altai Krai附近着陆。捷列什科娃后来成为苏联政坛的重要人物，至今仍保持着进入轨道时最年轻的女性纪录——26岁。

en: First mission to the Jupiter Trojans; visits 11 bodies across 8 asteroids and their satellites in a single 12-year trajectory — a record number of objects on separate solar orbits
cur: 首次访问木星特洛伊小行星群的任务；在单一的12年轨道中访问8颗小行星及其卫星上的11个天体——创纪录地访问最多的各自绕太阳公转的天体

en: Lucy reaches for the L4 and L5 Lagrange clouds — populations of primordial asteroids leading and trailing Jupiter by 60°, believed to preserve material from the outer protoplanetary disc. Three Earth gravity assists (2022, 2024, 2030) shape a single trajectory that visits seven Trojan asteroids plus bonus main-belt targets. First asteroid encounter: 152830 Dinkinesh (2023-11-01, ~790 m), at which imaging revealed the contact-binary satellite Selam. Bonus main-belt: Donaldjohanson 2025-04. L4 swarm: Eurybates + moon Queta (2027-08), Polymele (2027-09), Leucus (2028-04), Orus (2028-11). After EGA-3 (2030-12), the trailing L5 swarm: Patroclus-Menoetius binary (2033-03) — the largest Trojan binary known, a fitting climax for the mission's namesake (Lucy the hominid fossil; Patroclus-Menoetius the two characters that fell together in the Iliad).
cur: Lucy探向L4和L5拉格朗日点云——由行星形成时期遗留下来的原始小行星群，领先和落后于木星60°，被认为保留了外围原行星盘的物质。三次地球重力辅助(2022、2024、2030)形成单一轨道，访问7颗特洛伊小行星加上额外的主小行星带目标。首次小行星相遇：丁基内什星(2023-11-01，约790 m)，成像揭示了接触双星卫星Selam。主小行星带额外目标：唐纳德约翰森 2025-04。L4群：欧律巴特斯及其卫星Queta(2027-08)、波吕墨勒(2027-09)、琉科斯(2028-04)、奥鲁斯(2028-11)。在EGA-3(2030-12)之后，落后的L5群：帕特罗克洛斯-墨诺提俄斯双星(2033-03)——已知最大的特洛伊双星，是该任务的恰当高潮(任务以Lucy人类化石命名；帕特罗克洛斯-墨诺提俄斯是《伊利亚特》中一起陨落的两个人物)。

en: First asteroid sample ever returned to Earth (~1,500 grains of Itokawa dust, sub-milligram total)
cur: 有史以来首次从小行星返回样本到地球（约1,500粒糸川尘埃，总计不足1毫克）

en: JAXA's Hayabusa (Japanese for 'falcon') flew the most heroic mission-save in spaceflight history. Launched 2003-05-09 on an M-V-5 with four μ10 ion thrusters — the most powerful ion-propulsion subsystem flown to that point. Arrived at 25143 Itokawa 2005-09-12 — a 540×270×210-m rubble-pile near-Earth asteroid. Two touchdowns (2005-11-20 + 25), both with sample-collection projectile failures, though regolith was kicked into the collection horn anyway. Then a hydrazine leak crippled attitude control, two of its three reaction wheels failed, communications lost for seven weeks, the Earth-return window slipped by three years. Engineers assembled a single working ion engine from the surviving halves of two damaged engines and nursed Hayabusa back to Earth. Sample capsule recovered at Woomera AUS 2010-06-13 returned ~1,500 grains of Itokawa dust (sub-milligram total) — confirming the asteroid's S-type composition and rubble-pile structure, and proving that asteroid sample return was possible.
cur: JAXA的Hayabusa（日语意为"隼鹰"）执行了太空飞行历史上最英勇的任务拯救行动。2003年5月9日在M-V-5运载火箭上发射，搭载四台μ10离子推进器——当时飞行过的最强大的离子推进系统。2005年9月12日到达25143 糸川——一颗540×270×210米的碎片堆积近地小行星。进行了两次着陆（2005年11月20日和25日），两次都出现了样本采集弹射装置故障，但风化层仍然被吹入采集喇叭。随后肼泄漏瘫痪了姿态控制系统，三个反应轮中的两个失效，通信中断七周，地球返回窗口推迟了三年。工程师们用两台受损引擎的存活部分组装了一台工作的离子引擎，并将Hayabusa艰难送回地球。样本舱于2010年6月13日在伍默拉回收，返回了约1,500粒糸川尘埃（总计不足1毫克）——证实了小行星的S型成分和碎片堆积结构，并证明了小行星样本返回是可行的。

en: First mission dedicated to characterising the habitability of an icy moon; largest planetary mission spacecraft ever launched (6065 kg, 100-m² solar arrays)
cur: 首个专门表征冰冷卫星宜居性的任务;迄今发射的最大行星际任务航天器(6065 kg，100 m² 太阳能电池板)

en: Europa Clipper goes to Jupiter to study Europa — a 3,121-km icy moon believed to harbour a global liquid-water ocean beneath a 15-25 km ice shell, the most accessible potentially-habitable environment in the solar system. Launched 2024-10-14 on a Falcon Heavy at C3 41.7. A Mars gravity assist in March 2025 bent the trajectory toward Earth; an Earth gravity assist 2026-12 delivers the final push outward; arrives Jupiter 2030-04-11 for orbit insertion. The orbital tour executes 49 close Europa flybys over four years — passing within 25 km of Europa's surface on the closest passes, designed to map the entire moon while limiting the spacecraft's dose in Jupiter's brutal radiation belts. Instruments: REASON ice-penetrating radar, MASPEX mass spectrometer (samples plume material if any), E-THEMIS thermal imager (finds active geysers), magnetometer + plasma instruments confirm ocean depth from induced magnetic response.
cur: Europa Clipper前往木星研究木卫二——一颗直径3121 km的冰质卫星,被认为在15~25 km厚的冰壳下隐藏着全球液态水海洋,是太阳系内最容易接近的潜在宜居环境。于2024年10月14日在Falcon Heavy火箭上发射,C3速度为41.7 km²/s²。2025年3月的火星引力助推弯曲轨迹朝向地球;2026年12月的地球引力助推提供最后的外推力;2030年4月11日抵达木星进行轨道插入。轨道任务计划执行4年内的49次近距木卫二掠飞——最近距离掠过木卫二表面仅25 km,旨在绘制整个卫星地图,同时限制航天器在木星恶劣辐射带中的辐射剂量。仪器包括:REASON冰穿透雷达、MASPEX质谱仪(采样羽流物质,如有的话)、E-THEMIS热成像仪(探测活跃间歇泉)、磁强计和等离子体仪器通过感应磁响应确认海洋深度。

en: First spacecraft to orbit Jupiter; atmospheric probe into Jupiter clouds
cur: 第一个绕木星轨道运行的航天器；向木星大气释放探测器

en: Galileo should have been crippled before it even arrived. Its main antenna stuck half-open on the way to Jupiter, cutting its data rate to a trickle — and the mission succeeded anyway, because engineers rewrote its software from Earth to squeeze the science through a tiny backup antenna. It became the first spacecraft to orbit Jupiter, dropped a probe into the giant planet’s clouds, and spent eight years touring the moons. Its greatest find emerged slowly from that persistence: the way Jupiter’s magnetic field wrapped around Europa could only be explained by a salty ocean beneath the ice — the strongest case yet that a moon of Jupiter might hold liquid water, and life. At the end it was flown into Jupiter on purpose, so it could never fall onto Europa and contaminate it.
cur: Galileo本应在到达木星之前就已损坏。它的主天线在飞往木星的途中卡住了一半，将其数据速率降至极低——但该任务仍然取得了成功，因为地球上的工程师重写了其软件，使科学数据能通过一个微型备用天线传输。它成为了第一个绕木星轨道运行的航天器，向这颗巨型行星的大气投入了探测器，并花费了八年时间巡游各个卫星。其最伟大的发现是在这种坚持不懈中缓慢浮现的：木星磁场围绕木卫二的方式只能通过冰层下存在咸水洋来解释——这是迄今为止最有力的证据，表明木星的一个卫星可能蕴含液态水，甚至生命。最后，Galileo号被故意坠入木星，以确保它永远无法落在木卫二上并污染它。

en: Launched from Space Shuttle Atlantis after the long post-Challenger pause, Galileo braved the inner asteroid belt and conducted the first long-term study of Jupiter and its moons from orbit. It discovered Europa's induced magnetic field — strong evidence of a subsurface ocean — and watched Shoemaker-Levy 9 slam into Jupiter. The mission ended with a controlled plunge into Jupiter in 2003 to avoid contaminating icy moons that might harbour conditions for life.
cur: Galileo从 Space Shuttle Atlantis 上发射升空，这是Challenger事故后长期暂停后的首次任务，它穿过内小行星带，进行了第一次对木星及其卫星的长期轨道研究。它发现了木卫二诱导磁场——强有力的地下海洋证据——并目睹了苏梅克－列维9号彗星撞击木星。该任务以2003年有控制地坠入木星结束，以避免污染可能存在生命条件的冰质卫星。

en: Largest interplanetary spacecraft built in Europe; first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon of another planet (Ganymede, 2034)
cur: 欧洲制造的最大行星际飞行器；首个环绕另一行星卫星运行的飞行器（木卫三，2034年）

en: JUpiter ICy moons Explorer — ESA's L-class flagship, launched 2023-04-14. The 8-year cruise uses one of the most complex gravity-assist sequences ever flown: a first-of-kind Lunar-Earth Gravity Assist on 2024-08-19, Venus 2025-08-31, then two more Earth passes in 2026 and 2029. Jupiter orbit insertion is set for 2031-07-21. After 35 close flybys of Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto over 3.5 years, JUICE will manoeuvre into a dedicated Ganymede orbit on 2034-12-31 — the first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon of another planet. Mission ends 2035 by impact on Ganymede. Primary science: existence + properties of subsurface oceans across the icy Galilean moons, ice-shell composition + tidal heating, and Jovian magnetospheric structure.
cur: 木星冰月探测器——ESA的L级旗舰任务，于2023年4月14日发射。这次8年巡航采用了有史以来最复杂的重力助推序列之一：2024年8月19日进行首次月-地重力助推，2025年8月31日掠过金星，随后在2026年和2029年再进行两次地球近距离通过。木星轨道插入定于2031年7月21日进行。在3.5年内对木卫二、木卫三和木卫四进行35次近距离飞掠后，JUICE将在2034年12月31日机动进入木卫三专用轨道——首个环绕另一行星卫星运行的飞行器。任务于2035年以撞击木卫三结束。主要科学目标：探测冰月Galilean卫星群表面下洋的存在与特性、冰壳成分与潮汐加热，以及木星磁层结构。

en: First polar orbiter of Jupiter; solar-powered beyond the asteroid belt for the first time
cur: 木星首艘极轨道探测器；首次在小行星带以外以太阳能供电

en: Juno entered Jupiter orbit 2016-07-05 on a highly elliptical 53-day polar trajectory that takes it from inside the radiation belts (perijove ~4200 km above cloud tops) out past Callisto. Solar-powered — its ~50 m² triple-junction arrays deliver 14 kW at Earth but only ~500 W at Jupiter, the first time solar power has been used at that distance. Confirmed Jupiter has a diluted rocky core (not a sharp boundary), measured the polar cyclone arrangement (eight circumpolar storms around each pole), and imaged Io’s volcanism at unprecedented detail in 2023. Extended mission includes flybys of all four Galilean moons through 2025.
cur: Juno 在 2016-07-05 进入木星轨道，采用高度椭圆的 53 天极地轨迹，从辐射带内部（近木点距云顶约 4200 公里）运行到木卫四之外。由太阳能驱动——其约 50 平方米的三结太阳能电池阵列在地球处可提供 14 千瓦功率，但在木星处仅约 500 瓦，这是太阳能首次用于这么远的距离。证实了木星拥有一个稀释的岩石核心（没有明确的边界），测量了极地气旋排列（每极周围有八个环极风暴），并在 2023 年以前所未有的细节拍摄了木卫一的火山活动。扩展任务包括通过 2025 年对四颗伽利略卫星的全部近距离飞行。

en: First spacecraft through the asteroid belt and the first to fly past Jupiter (1973-12-04)
cur: 首艘穿越小行星带、首艘飞掠木星的航天器(1973-12-04)

en: Pioneer 10 went first, into two dangers nobody had measured. No spacecraft had crossed the asteroid belt — thought to be a shooting gallery of debris — or survived Jupiter’s radiation, believed lethal to electronics. Pioneer 10 did both: it crossed the belt unharmed (the belt, it turned out, is mostly empty), reached Jupiter in December 1973 as the first spacecraft ever to do so, and returned the first close images of the giant planet. Then it became the first human-made object aimed out of the solar system for good. Its value was proof — it turned the unknown hazards on the road to the outer planets into known ones, so the Voyagers could be built to face them.
cur: Pioneer 10率先出发,驶入两片无人测量过的险域。此前没有任何航天器穿越过小行星带——人们认为那是碎片横飞的射击场——也没有任何航天器在木星辐射中幸存,人们相信那辐射对电子设备是致命的。Pioneer 10两者都做到了:它毫发无损地穿越了小行星带(事实证明,小行星带大部分是空的),于1973年12月抵达木星,成为有史以来第一个做到这一点的航天器,并传回了这颗巨行星的第一批近距离图像。随后它成为第一个被永久射向太阳系之外的人造物体。它的价值在于证明——它把通往外行星之路上的未知危险变成了已知危险,使Voyager探测器得以针对这些危险进行建造。

en: Pioneer 10 was the trail-blazer — first to cross the asteroid belt (which we then learned was much less hazardous than predicted), first to image Jupiter at close range, first to reach a heliocentric distance greater than Pluto’s perihelion (1983). It carries the Pioneer plaque designed by Carl Sagan, Frank Drake, and Linda Salzman Sagan — humanity’s first deliberate interstellar message. Final successful contact 2003-01-23 from ~82 AU; the spacecraft now drifts toward the constellation Taurus, with an encounter near Aldebaran in roughly two million years.
cur: Pioneer 10 开路探险 — 首艘穿越小行星带的探测器(后来证实远不如担心的那般危险),首艘近距离拍摄木星的探测器,首艘超越冥王星近日距(1983)的航天器。它搭载着卡尔·萨根、法兰克·德雷克与琳达·萨尔茨曼设计的先驱者镀金板 — 人类首次有意识的星际信息。最后一次成功通讯于 2003-01-23,距离约 82 AU;探测器如今飘向金牛座方向,约两百万年后将经过毕宿五附近。

en: First nuclear-powered Mars rover; first sky-crane landing
cur: 首个核动力火星探测器；首次天空起重机着陆

en: Curiosity is a nuclear-powered laboratory the size of a small car, and getting it down was the hard part. Too heavy for airbags, it was lowered onto Mars in 2012 by a rocket-powered sky crane in a sequence so risky its planners called it seven minutes of terror — and it worked on the first try. Since then it has drilled its way across Gale Crater and answered the question it was sent to ask: the crater once held a lake, with the chemistry a living thing could have used. Mars had been habitable. Curiosity is still driving, climbing a mountain of layered rock that reads like the planet’s own history book.
cur: Curiosity是一个核动力实验室，大小如一辆小汽车，而将其送上火星才是最艰巨的挑战。因质量过重无法使用充气垫，2012年它通过火箭动力的天空起重机被放到了火星表面。这一着陆序列危险至极，以至于计划者称之为"恐怖的七分钟"——而它在第一次尝试中就成功了。自那以后，Curiosity在盖尔撞击坑内钻探移动，并回答了它被派遣去回答的问题：这个陨石坑曾经存在一个湖泊，其化学成分可以支持生命存在。火星曾经宜居。Curiosity仍在继续行驶，攀爬着一座层状岩石山，它就像火星自己的历史书。

en: The flagship mission that defined modern Mars exploration. Curiosity is car-sized, plutonium-powered, and has driven 36+ km across Gale Crater since landing in 2012. Its instruments confirmed Mars once had habitable conditions — flowing water, complex organics, the chemistry life would need. The 'seven minutes of terror' EDL sequence, ending with a sky-crane lowering the rover on cables, is now NASA's standard for delivering large payloads to Mars surface.
cur: 定义了现代火星探测的旗舰任务。Curiosity车身大小如小汽车，由钚-238提供动力，自2012年着陆以来已在盖尔撞击坑内行驶超过36千米。其仪器确认火星曾经具备宜居条件——流动的水、复杂的有机物、生命所需的化学成分。"恐怖的七分钟"进入、下降、着陆序列以天空起重机通过缆绳放下火星车而告终，现已成为NASA向火星表面运送大型载荷的标准方案。

en: The Emirates Mars Mission — Al Amal, 'Hope' — was conceived in 2014 to mark the 50th anniversary of UAE federation in 2021. The MBRSC team partnered with the University of Colorado, Arizona State, and UC Berkeley to design and integrate the spacecraft, but built it themselves. The science orbit (55-hour period, ~20,000 km × 43,000 km) covers all longitudes and times of day, capturing weather patterns no other Mars orbiter can resolve. The mission succeeded on the first attempt, making the UAE the fifth agency at Mars.
cur: 阿联酋火星探测任务——Al Amal"希望"号——构想于2014年，旨在纪念阿联酋联邦成立50周年（2021年）。MBRSC团队与科罗拉多大学、亚利桑那州立大学和加州大学伯克利分校合作设计并整合该航天器，但由他们自己建造。该科学轨道（周期55小时，约20,000公里×43,000公里）覆盖所有经度和一天中的所有时间，能够捕捉其他火星轨道飞行器无法分辨的天气模式。该任务在首次尝试中就成功了，使阿联酋成为到达火星的第五个机构。

en: First seismometer on Mars; first interplanetary launch from US West Coast
cur: 火星上的首个地震仪；美国西海岸的首次行星际发射

en: InSight gave Mars its first stethoscope. Its seismometer, deployed by a robotic arm onto the regolith, recorded over 1,300 marsquakes — including a magnitude-5 in 2022, the largest ever detected on another planet. The data revealed Mars's interior structure: a 1,800-km-radius molten core, a thick crust, and surprising mantle layering. The mole heat-flow experiment failed when the regolith proved too cohesive for its self-hammering design. The mission ended when dust accumulation on solar panels reduced power below operational threshold.
cur: InSight 为火星配备了第一个“听诊器”。它的地震仪由机械臂部署在火星表土上，记录了超过1300次火星地震——包括2022年发生的5级地震，这是迄今在其他星球上探测到的最强地震。数据揭示了火星的内部结构：半径为1800公里的熔融核心、厚重的地壳，以及出人意料的地幔分层。“鼹鼠”热流实验失败了，因为火星表土的粘聚力超出了其自锤击设计的承受能力。当太阳能电池板上积尘使功率降至运行阈值以下时，任务宣告结束。

en: First Asian Mars mission; first Mars success on first attempt
cur: 首个亚洲火星任务；首次尝试即成功到达火星

en: ISRO's Mars Orbiter Mission cost $74 million — less than the budget of the film Gravity ($100M), and a fraction of NASA's MAVEN ($671M) which arrived two days earlier. Built in 18 months as a technology demonstrator, Mangalyaan succeeded at every objective: trans-Mars injection, deep-space navigation, Mars orbit insertion, and 8 years of science return. India became the fourth space agency at Mars and the first to succeed on its first try.
cur: ISRO的火星轨道器任务耗资7400万美元——低于电影《地心引力》(1亿美元)的预算,也远少于NASA的MAVEN(6.71亿美元),后者提前两天抵达。Mangalyaan作为技术演示验证项目,在18个月内完成,圆满实现了所有目标:火星转移注入、深空导航、火星轨道插入以及8年的科学回报。印度成为火星上第四个航天机构,也是第一个在首次尝试中就取得成功的国家。

en: First spacecraft to reach Mars and return close-up images of another planet
cur: 首个到达火星并拍摄另一颗行星近距离图像的航天器

en: The mission that ended dreams of a habitable Mars. Mariner 4's 22 grainy images, taken during a 25-minute closest approach at 9,846 km altitude, showed a cratered surface resembling the Moon — no canals, no vegetation, no obvious life. The atmosphere was 100× thinner than expected. The discovery reshaped Mars in the public imagination from sister-Earth to dead world. Tracking the spacecraft also produced the first measurement of the solar wind's structure between planets.
cur: 这个任务终结了人们关于宜居火星的梦想。Mariner 4在距离9,846公里的高度进行了25分钟的最近接近时拍摄了22张粗粒度图像，显示出一个布满陨石坑的表面，类似于月球——没有运河，没有植被，没有明显的生命迹象。大气密度比预期薄100倍。这一发现在公众想象中将火星从类地姐妹星球重新塑造成荒凉世界。对这艘航天器的追踪还产生了首次测量行星间太阳风结构的成果。

en: Mariner 9 made every orbiter that followed possible. After a 15-minute MOI burn placed it into Mars orbit on 1971-11-14, the planet below was unrecognisable — a global dust storm had hidden everything except the four Tharsis volcano summits. JPL waited it out. Through January 1972 the dust settled and Mariner 9 returned 7,329 images covering ~85% of the Martian surface, revealing Olympus Mons (the largest volcano in the solar system), Valles Marineris (the canyon system that bears its name), dried river channels suggesting an ancient liquid era, and the first close-ups of Phobos and Deimos. The mission ended 1972-10-27 when attitude-control gas ran out; the spacecraft remains in orbit, slowly decaying.
cur: Mariner 9 使所有后续的轨道器任务成为可能。在1971年11月14日经过15分钟的火星轨道插入（MOI）变轨后，下方的火星面目全非——一场全球性尘暴隐藏了除塔尔西斯高原四座火山顶峰外的一切。喷气推进实验室（JPL）耐心等待。整个1972年1月，尘埃逐渐沉降，Mariner 9 共传回7329幅图像，覆盖火星表面约85%，揭示了奥林帕斯山（太阳系最大的火山）、水手号峡谷（该峡谷因之得名）、暗示存在古代液态水的干涸河道，以及火卫一和火卫二的首批近距离照片。任务于1972年10月27日结束，当时姿态控制气体耗尽；该航天器仍在轨道上，缓慢衰减。

en: Europe's first interplanetary mission; longest-running non-NASA Mars orbiter
cur: 欧洲首次行星际探测任务；运行时间最长的非NASA火星轨道器

en: ESA's first mission to a planet other than Earth. The orbiter has produced the longest continuous record of Mars's atmosphere, mapping water ice deposits, methane plumes, and the planet's three-dimensional weather. Beagle 2, the British-built lander it carried, reached the surface but never deployed solar panels fully — declared lost in 2004, found intact by NASA's Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter in 2015. The orbiter is in its third decade of operation.
cur: ESA首次前往除地球外行星的任务。该轨道器生成了最长的火星大气连续记录，绘制了水冰沉积、甲烷羽流及行星三维气象的分布图。它搭载的英国制造登陆器Beagle 2到达了火星表面，但太阳能电池板始终未能完全展开——在2004年被宣布丧失，后于2015年被NASA的Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter完整发现。该轨道器目前已运行进入第三个十年。

en: Mars Pathfinder was NASA’s proof that landing on Mars did not have to cost a fortune. Instead of the retrorocket hover the Vikings used, it hit the atmosphere behind a heat shield, popped a parachute, inflated a cocoon of airbags, and bounced dozens of times across the surface before rolling to a stop and opening like a flower. Out drove Sojourner — a rover the size of a microwave, the first wheels ever to turn on another planet. The science was modest; the point was the method. The airbag landing and the faster-cheaper-better approach it proved became the template for the far more ambitious rovers — Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity — that followed.
cur: Mars Pathfinder 证明了NASA登陆火星不必花费巨资。它没有采用Vikings使用的减速火箭悬停方式，而是躲在隔热罩后面撞入大气，弹出降落伞，充气形成气囊保护舱，在表面弹跳数十次后滚动停止，最后像花朵一样绽放打开。Sojourner 漫游车由此驶出——一个微波炉大小的漫游车，是有史以来在另一个星球上转动的第一批轮子。科学意义不大，但方法很新颖。气囊着陆及其所证明的更快、更便宜、更好的方法，成为了后来更加雄心勃勃的漫游车——Spirit、Opportunity、Curiosity——的模板。

en: The mission that proved cheap interplanetary missions could work. Pathfinder used a novel airbag landing system — bouncing dozens of times across the surface before coming to rest — and delivered Sojourner, the first rover to operate on another planet. Sojourner traversed 100 m, examined a dozen rocks, and worked far past its 8-sol design lifetime. Pathfinder operated for 2 months 27 days; the mission's success revived NASA's interplanetary programme after the failures of the 1990s.
cur: 证明廉价星际任务可行的里程碑任务。Pathfinder 采用了新颖的气囊着陆系统——在表面弹跳数十次后停止——并搭载了 Sojourner，这是第一台在另一个星球上运作的漫游车。Sojourner 行驶了 100 米，检查了约 12 块岩石，且远超其 8 火星日的设计寿命。Pathfinder 运作了 2 个月 27 天；该任务的成功在 1990 年代失败后重振了NASA的星际探测计划。

en: The Soviet Union's audacious double-mission to Mars in 1971 — Mars 2 and Mars 3 launched 9 days apart. Mars 2's lander crashed; Mars 3's lander achieved the first soft-landing on Mars but went silent ~110 seconds after touchdown — the actual transmission lasted only ~14.5 seconds — possibly due to the global dust storm raging at the time. The orbiter operated for 8 months, returning dozens of images and atmospheric measurements. Despite the brief surface mission, Mars 3 demonstrated that the descent and landing problem on Mars was solvable.
cur: 苏联在1971年对火星进行的大胆双重任务——Mars 2和Mars 3相隔9天发射。Mars 2的着陆器坠毁；Mars 3的着陆器实现了火星上的首次软着陆，但在接触后约110秒内沉寂——实际传输仅持续约14.5秒——可能是由于当时肆虐的全球尘暴所致。轨道器运行了8个月，返回了数十张图像和大气测量数据。尽管表面任务时间很短，Mars 3证明了火星上的下降和着陆问题是可以解决的。

en: MAVEN — Mars Atmosphere and Volatile Evolution — answers the question 'where did Mars's air go?' Its elliptical orbit dips into the upper atmosphere, sampling ions and neutrals as the solar wind strips them away. Findings: Mars loses about 100 g of atmosphere per second to space — over billions of years that's enough to explain the missing climate. The spacecraft also serves as a critical relay for surface assets, including Curiosity and Perseverance.
cur: MAVEN — 火星大气与挥发物演化探测器 — 回答了"火星的空气去了哪里？"这个问题。其椭圆轨道深入上层大气，对太阳风剥离的离子和中性粒子进行采样。研究发现：火星每秒流失约 100 克的大气到太空 — 在数十亿年的时间尺度上，这足以解释消失的气候。该航天器还作为表面资产的关键中继站，包括 Curiosity 和 Perseverance。

en: Martian Moons eXploration is JAXA's plan to land on Phobos, scoop ~10 g of regolith, and bring it home. The samples may settle a long-debated question: are Phobos and Deimos captured asteroids, or fragments from an ancient impact on Mars itself? The mission also includes a German-French rover for Phobos surface mobility — a wholly different operations model from anything the Hayabusa missions did at Itokawa or Ryugu. Launch was planned for 2024 but slipped to 2026 due to delays in JAXA's H3 launch vehicle.
cur: Martian Moons eXploration是JAXA登陆火卫一、铲取约10克风化层样本并将其带回地球的计划。这些样本可能会解决一个长期争议的问题：火卫一和火卫二是捕获的小行星，还是源自火星本身的一次古老撞击的碎片？该任务还包括一台用于火卫一表面机动的德法联合漫游车——这是一个与Hayabusa系列任务在小行星丝川和龙宫上执行的任何操作模式都完全不同的运作模式。发射原计划在2024年进行，但因JAXA的H3运载火箭延迟而推迟至2026年。

en: Longest-driving Mars rover (45.16 km); 14-year surface lifetime against a 90-sol design
cur: 行驶距离最远的火星漫游车（45.16 km）；服役14年，远超90火星日设计寿命

en: Opportunity drove a marathon across another planet. Spirit’s twin, landed in 2004 for a ninety-day mission, it worked for fourteen years and crossed more than forty-five kilometres — the longest distance any vehicle has travelled on any world. It came down, by luck, in a small crater whose walls exposed exactly the water-laid rock it was sent to find, and then it just kept going, crater to crater, reading the ancient water story of Mars mile after mile. A planet-wide dust storm finally silenced it in 2018.
cur: Opportunity 在另一颗行星上驾驶了一次马拉松。作为 Spirit 的孪生姐妹，它在2004年着陆执行一项为期九十天的任务，却在火星表面工作了十四年，行驶超过四十五公里——任何航天器在任何星球上行驶的最远距离。幸运的是，它着陆在一个小陨石坑中，坑壁暴露出了大量水成岩石——正是它被派来寻找的证据。随后它继续行进，从一个陨石坑到另一个，一公里一公里地讲述火星古代的水文故事。2018年，一场全球尘暴最终让它沉默了。

en: Opportunity (MER-B) hit a planetary jackpot — its airbag-cocooned lander bounced 26 times across Meridiani Planum and rolled into a 22-m crater (Eagle) by sheer luck, surrounded by exposed bedrock a rover could read without driving. First images showed jarosite + "blueberry" hematite concretions, the strongest mineral evidence to that point of standing liquid water on early Mars. Over 14 years 138 days (5,111 sols) Opportunity traversed 45.16 km — the Mars rover marathon record — visiting Endurance, Victoria, and Endeavour craters. A planet-wide dust storm in June 2018 blocked sunlight from its solar panels; final transmission was 2018-06-10, and NASA declared end-of-mission 2019-02-13.
cur: Opportunity (MER-B) 赢得了行星奖励——其气囊保护的着陆器在子午线高原上反弹了26次，凭借纯粹的幸运坠入了一个22米的陨石坑（Eagle），周围被崖露基岩所环绕，漫游车无需远行就能观测。首批图像显示了黄钾铁矾和"蓝莓"赤铁矿球粒体，这是当时关于火星早期存在液态水最有力的矿物证据。在14年138天（5,111个火星日）内，Opportunity 行驶了45.16 km——火星漫游车马拉松纪录保持者——访问了Endurance、Victoria和Endeavour陨石坑。2018年6月的一场全球尘暴遮挡了阳光，阻碍了其太阳能电池板的供电；最后一次传输信号于2018-06-10，NASA 于2019-02-13宣布任务结束。

en: First helicopter on another planet (Ingenuity); first sample caching for Mars Sample Return
cur: 首架火星上的直升机（Ingenuity）；火星样本返回计划的首次样本采集与缓存

en: Perseverance went to Mars to look for the dead. Landed in 2021 on the floor of Jezero Crater — a basin holding the delta of a river that fed a lake billions of years ago, exactly the kind of place life would have left traces — it is the first rover built specifically to search for signs of ancient life, and to do something no mission had done: seal Martian rock into tubes and set them aside for a future spacecraft to carry home. It also delivered Ingenuity, the small helicopter that made the first powered flight on another planet. If the samples it is caching are ever returned, they will be the first pieces of another planet’s surface brought back to Earth.
cur: Perseverance来到火星寻找逝去的生命。它于2021年降落在耶泽罗撞击坑的底部——这是一个盆地，曾被一条古河三角洲注入，那条河在数十亿年前流入一个湖泊，正是生命会留下痕迹的地方——它是第一个专为寻找古代生命迹象而设计的火星车，并实现了任何前期任务都未曾完成的壮举：将火星岩石封入管状容器并妥善保存，等待未来的航天器将其运回地球。它还搭载了Ingenuity，这架小型直升机实现了人类首次在另一个星球上的动力飞行。如果它缓存的样本有朝一日被运回，它们将成为首批从另一个星球表面带回地球的物质。

en: Perseverance is the most ambitious Mars surface mission ever flown. Mars Sample Return depends on it — the rover is collecting and caching samples in tubes that a future mission will retrieve and bring to Earth. Ingenuity, the first helicopter on another planet, flew 72 missions before retiring with damaged rotors in January 2024 — proving controlled flight is possible in Mars's thin atmosphere. MOXIE, an oxygen-from-CO2 demonstrator, produced the first locally-made oxygen on another planet, a rehearsal for crewed Mars missions.
cur: Perseverance 是有史以来最宏大的火星表面探测任务。火星样本返回计划依靠它——该漫游车正在收集样本并将其装入管子中缓存，以供未来的任务检索并运回地球。Ingenuity 是另一颗行星上的第一架直升机，在 2024 年 1 月因转子受损而停止服役前执行了 72 次飞行，证明了在火星稀薄大气中进行受控飞行是可能的。MOXIE 是一个从 CO2 中提取氧气的演示系统，在另一颗行星上生产了第一批本地制造的氧气，为载人火星任务进行了演练。

en: First confirmation of water ice in the Martian arctic regolith; first soft propulsive Mars landing since Viking 2
cur: 首次确认火星极地风化层存在水冰；自Viking 2以来首次软着陆推进式火星着陆

en: Phoenix was salvaged from the cancelled Mars Surveyor 2001 program — flight hardware in storage for six years, reassembled and retargeted to the Martian north polar plains. The name was chosen literally. Landed 2008-05-25 at 68.22°N, 234.25°E on Vastitas Borealis, further north than any prior surface mission. Within days the robotic arm scraped through topsoil and exposed bright white ice that visibly sublimated on camera over four sols — direct confirmation of subsurface water ice in the Martian arctic. Detected perchlorates in the regolith and observed snow falling from clouds. Mission ended 2008-11-02 as solar power fell below operational threshold at the onset of Mars winter; the lander was never expected to survive the polar night.
cur: Phoenix由取消的火星 Surveyor 2001计划打捞而来——飞行硬件在仓库中存放了六年，重新组装并重新瞄准火星北极平原。其名称取其字面之义。于2008年5月25日着陆于北方荒原的68.22°N, 234.25°E，比此前任何表面任务都更靠北。机械臂在数日内刮开表土，暴露出明亮的白色冰层，在相机镜头下可见其在四个火星日内升华——直接确认了火星极地地下存在水冰。在风化层中探测到高氯酸盐，并观测到云层降雪。任务于2008年11月2日结束，因太阳能功率降至运行阈值以下，火星冬季来临；着陆器本就不被期望能在极夜中存活。

en: ESA's first Mars surface attempt; intended to demonstrate EDL ahead of ExoMars Rosalind Franklin
cur: ESA首次火星表面着陆尝试；旨在为ExoMars Rosalind Franklin演示EDL能力

en: Schiaparelli was the entry-descent-landing demonstrator carried piggyback on the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter (TGO). Named for the Italian astronomer Giovanni Schiaparelli, the craft was built to prove the EDL stack ESA intended to scale up for the Rosalind Franklin rover. Schiaparelli separated from TGO on 16 October 2016 and entered the Martian atmosphere three days later. The descent profile collapsed: a saturated inertial measurement unit caused the navigation software to think the craft had already landed at altitude — the parachute jettisoned early and the braking thrusters cut off after firing for only 3 seconds. Schiaparelli struck the surface at ~150 m/s. TGO itself completed orbit insertion successfully and continues operating.
cur: Schiaparelli是搭载在ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter (TGO)上的进入-下降-着陆演示器。该航天器以意大利天文学家乔凡尼·斯基亚帕雷利的名字命名，旨在验证ESA计划为Rosalind Franklin漫游车扩展应用的EDL堆栈。Schiaparelli于2016年10月16日与TGO分离，三天后进入火星大气层。下降过程遭遇失败：饱和的惯性测量单元导致导航软件错误地认为该航天器已在高空着陆——降落伞提前抛弃，制动推进器在仅点火3秒后关闭。Schiaparelli以约150米/秒的速度撞击地表。TGO本身成功完成了轨道插入并继续运行。

en: First of the Mars Exploration Rover twins; longest-lived rover until passed by Curiosity
cur: 火星探测漫游者双子星之一；在Curiosity超越之前是寿命最长的火星车

en: Spirit was built for ninety days and worked for six years. One of a pair of golf-cart-sized geologists landed in 2004, it was sent to read the rocks for evidence of a wetter Martian past — and it found it, uncovering minerals that only form in water and, in one place, silica deposits like those left by hot springs on Earth. It climbed hills no one had planned for it to reach and survived winters it was never designed to see, until a wheel failed and it bogged down in soft sand. It kept transmitting from where it was stuck until the Martian cold finally took it.
cur: Spirit设计工作期限为九十天，实际工作了六年。作为一对高尔夫球车大小的地质学家，它在2004年着陆，其使命是通过岩石来寻找火星曾经更湿润的证据——它确实找到了，发现了只能在水中形成的矿物，在一个地点还找到了类似地球温泉沉积的硅质矿床。它爬过没有人预期它能到达的山丘，熬过了它从未被设计来承受的严冬，直到一个车轮失效，它陷入了松软的沙土。它从困顿之处继续发送信号，直到火星的严寒最终摧毁了它。

en: Spirit (MER-A) bounced 28 times across the floor of Gusev Crater on 2004-01-04 and rolled to a stop 250 m from its first impact. Designed for a 90-sol primary mission, it would survive 2,208 sols. Drove 7.7 km across Gusev's plains, climbed the Columbia Hills, and uncovered hematite-bearing rocks that signalled persistent ancient water. In 2009-04 a wheel broke through a sulphate crust at "Troy" and Spirit ground to a halt in soft soil; the team converted it to a stationary platform. Final transmission 2010-03-22; mission declared ended 2011-05-25. Twinned with Opportunity, which landed three weeks later on the opposite side of Mars.
cur: Spirit（MER-A）在2004年1月4日于古瑟夫撞击坑底部反弹28次，从首次撞击点滚动250 m后停下。它按90火星日的主任务设计，却存活了2,208火星日。它在古谢夫平原上行驶了7.7 km，攀登了哥伦比亚丘陵，并发现了含赤铁矿的岩石，表明火星曾有持久的古代水活动。2009年4月，一个车轮在“Troy”处压穿硫酸盐地壳，Spirit陷入软土无法动弹；团队将其改作固定平台。最后信号发送于2010年3月22日；任务于2011年5月25日宣布结束。它与Opportunity是孪生任务，Opportunity三周后在火星另一侧着陆。

en: First fully reusable launch system to attempt Mars landing
cur: 首个尝试火星登陆的完全可重复使用运载系统

en: An uncrewed demonstration of the Starship Mars architecture: launch on Super Heavy, refill in LEO from a tanker variant, then trans-Mars injection of a fully-fuelled Starship and powered descent to the Martian surface. SpaceX's stated target is a 2026-2027 launch window; engineering reality (Starship still working through orbital flight reliability and on-orbit refilling has not been demonstrated) makes 2028 or later more likely. If it succeeds, it inverts the Mars payload economics — from thousands of kg to one hundred tonnes per landing.
cur: Starship火星架构的无人示范任务：在Super Heavy上发射，从油箱变体在近地轨道补充燃料，然后进行火星转移注入和完全加满燃料的Starship动力下降到火星表面。SpaceX宣称的目标是2026-2027年发射窗口；但工程现实（Starship仍在进行轨道飞行可靠性测试，轨道补燃还未得到演证）使得2028年或更晚时间更为可能。如果成功，它将颠覆火星载荷经济学——从数千公斤增加到每次登陆一百吨。

en: First proposed crewed return mission to Mars (SpaceX architecture)
cur: 首个提议的载人火星往返任务（SpaceX 方案）

en: SpaceX's long-term crewed Mars architecture as outlined in Elon Musk's 2016, 2017, and 2024 IAC presentations. A Starship lifts off from Earth fully fuelled in low-Earth orbit via a fleet of refilling tanker flights, performs trans-Mars injection, and lands a crew of roughly 10 with cargo and ISRU equipment on the Martian surface. Return-leg propellant (methane + liquid oxygen) is manufactured on Mars from atmospheric CO₂ and subsurface water ice via the Sabatier process, enabling the same Starship to lift off again, perform trans-Earth injection, and return the crew. Round-trip duration depends on the launch window and surface stay; the illustrative timeline shown here is ~2.5 years door-to-door (213 days outbound, ~500-day surface stay, return on the next favourable window). The architecture is conceptual — date and parameters subject to substantial revision pending Starship maturation and ISRU validation.
cur: SpaceX 的长期载人火星建筑方案，如埃隆·马斯克在 2016 年、2017 年和 2024 年 IAC 演讲中所述。Starship 从地球起飞时在近地轨道上完全加注燃料，需要通过一支加油油轮飞队进行多次补给，执行火星转移注入，并将约 10 名乘员及货物和 ISRU 设备送达火星表面。返回阶段推进剂（甲烷+液态氧）通过 Sabatier 工艺利用火星大气中的二氧化碳和地下冰储备在火星上制造，使同一 Starship 能够再次起飞、执行地球转移注入并将乘员送回。往返时间取决于发射窗口和地表停留时间；此处所示的示意时间表约为 2.5 年（门到门），包括 213 天的往程、约 500 天的地表停留以及在下一个有利窗口返回。该建筑方案具有概念性——具体日期和参数在 Starship 成熟度提高和 ISRU 验证完成后可能会进行重大修订。

en: First mission to deliver orbiter, lander, and rover to Mars in a single launch
cur: 首次在单次发射中向火星交付轨道器、着陆器和火星车的任务

en: China's first Mars mission accomplished what no agency had ever attempted in one launch: orbital insertion, atmospheric entry, soft landing, and rover deployment. The Zhurong rover operated 358 sols at Utopia Planitia, traversing 1.9 km, before entering planned hibernation in May 2022; it has not woken since (likely due to dust accumulation on solar panels). The orbiter remains active, mapping the planet at high resolution and serving as relay for ground assets.
cur: 中国首次火星任务完成了任何航天机构从未在单次发射中尝试过的壮举：轨道插入、大气层进入、软着陆和火星车部署。祝融火星车在乌托邦平原运行了358个火星日，行驶1.9千米，之后在2022年5月进入计划中的冬眠状态；此后便再未苏醒（可能是由于太阳能电池板上的尘埃积累）。轨道器仍在继续工作，以高分辨率绘制行星地图，并为地面资产充当中继。

en: First fully successful Mars landing; first long-duration surface science
cur: 火星首次完全成功的着陆；首次长期表面科学探测

en: The mission that gave us our first sustained look at the Martian surface. Viking 1's lander operated for 6 years 4 months at Chryse Planitia — running biology experiments designed to detect life (results ambiguous; one experiment produced a positive signal still debated decades later), measuring weather, returning panoramic images, and analysing soil composition. The Viking orbiters together mapped 97% of Mars at ~300 m resolution and helped scout landing sites for missions still decades away.
cur: 这项任务使我们首次对火星表面进行了持续观测。Viking 1着陆器在克律塞平原运行了6年4个月——进行生物学实验以探测生命（结果模棱两可；一项实验产生的正信号至今仍有争议），测量气象数据，返回全景图像，并分析土壤成分。两个Viking轨道器共绘制了火星97%的表面地形图，分辨率约300 m，并为数十年后的登陆任务进行了着陆点侦察。

en: First Europe + Japan joint planetary mission; second-ever spacecraft to orbit Mercury (after Messenger)
cur: 欧洲与日本首次联合行星任务；第二个绕水星运行的航天器（继Messenger之后）

en: Joint ESA / JAXA mission to Mercury, launched 2018-10-20 — named after Italian mathematician Giuseppe (Bepi) Colombo, who designed Mariner 10's multi-flyby trajectory. The 8-year cruise uses 9 gravity assists (Earth 2020, Venus 2020, Venus 2021, then six Mercury flybys 2021–2025) plus continuous ion-electric thrust from the Mercury Transfer Module to bleed off the enormous solar-gravity gradient between Earth and Mercury orbits. Mercury orbit insertion 2026-11-21; science operations begin early 2027 after MTM jettison and separation of the two orbiters — ESA's MPO (planetary surface + composition) and JAXA's Mio (magnetosphere). Tests of general relativity via radio-science range tracking through Mercury's strong solar-gravity environment are also planned.
cur: 欧航局/JAXA联合水星任务，2018年10月20日发射——以设计Mariner 10多次飞掠轨迹的意大利数学家Giuseppe（Bepi）Colombo的名字命名。8年的巡航阶段利用9次引力辅助（2020年地球、2020年金星、2021年金星，随后2021–2025年六次水星飞掠），以及来自水星转移舱的连续离子电推力，以抵消地球与水星轨道间巨大的太阳引力梯度。水星轨道到达时间2026年11月21日；在水星转移舱抛弃和两个卫星分离后，科学观测于2027年初开始——ESA的MPO（行星表面及成分）和JAXA的Mio（磁层）。还计划通过水星强太阳引力环境中的无线电科学测距追踪进行广义相对论测试。

en: First Mercury flyby; first dual-planet flyby; first gravity-assist mission
cur: 首次水星飞越；首次双行星飞越；首次引力辅助任务

en: First spacecraft to visit Mercury, first to fly past two planets, and first to use a gravity assist to reach its destination. Launched 1973-11-03 05:45 UTC from Cape Canaveral LC-36B on Atlas SLV-3D Centaur AC-34. Mariner 10 swung past Venus on 1974-02-05 (5768 km closest approach, first UV cloud-belt imaging of Venus) using the encounter to drop its perihelion into Mercury's orbital realm — the first deliberate gravity-assist trajectory in space history. Made three Mercury flybys: 1974-03-29 (703 km), 1974-09-21 (48069 km), and 1975-03-16 (327 km). Imaged ~45% of Mercury's surface — the only resolved imagery available until MESSENGER (2008-2015). Discovered Mercury's intrinsic magnetic field and thin sodium-helium exosphere. Solar-array temperature management was an open mission engineering problem: project scientists tilted the panels and rolled the spacecraft to keep them under 115°C. Mission ended 1975-03-24 when attitude-control nitrogen propellant was depleted; spacecraft is presumed to be in heliocentric orbit, periodically passing Mercury.
cur: 首个造访水星的航天器，首个飞越两颗行星的航天器，也是首个利用引力辅助到达目的地的航天器。1973-11-03 05:45 UTC由Atlas SLV-3D Centaur AC-34从卡纳维拉尔角 LC-36B发射。Mariner 10在1974-02-05飞越金星（最近距离5768公里，首次对金星云带进行紫外成像），并利用这次相遇将其近日点降至水星的轨道范围 — 太空史上首次有意为之的引力辅助轨道。完成了三次水星飞越：1974-03-29（703公里）、1974-09-21（48069公里）和1975-03-16（327公里）。对水星约45%的表面进行了成像 — 在MESSENGER（2008-2015）之前唯一可用的解析图像。发现了水星固有磁场以及稀薄的钠-氦外逸层。太阳能电池板的温度管理是一个尚未解决的任务工程难题：项目科学家通过倾斜电池板并使航天器滚转，将其温度保持在115°C以下。任务于1975-03-24结束，姿态控制氮气推进剂耗尽；该航天器被推测处于日心轨道，周期性地从水星附近经过。

en: First spacecraft to orbit Mercury; first complete surface map of the innermost planet
cur: 首个绕水星运行的航天器；首个绘制这颗最内侧行星完整表面地图的任务

en: MESSENGER (MErcury Surface, Space ENvironment, GEochemistry, and Ranging) used six gravity assists across seven years — Earth, Venus twice, Mercury three times — to slow into Mercury orbit on 2011-03-18. Sunshade-protected with one side at 370 °C and the other at -45 °C. Discoveries included water ice in permanently shadowed polar craters, previously unknown “hollows” geological features, and confirmation that Mercury's iron core occupies ~85 % of the planet's radius (the largest core-to-radius ratio of any planet in the solar system). Mission ended with a controlled impact onto Mercury’s surface 2015-04-30 after fuel ran out.
cur: MESSENGER（水星表面、空间环境、地球化学和遥感测量，英文全称 MErcury Surface, Space ENvironment, GEochemistry, and Ranging）利用六次重力辅助加速——分别来自地球、金星两次、水星三次——花费七年时间逐步减速，于2011-03-18进入水星轨道。采用遮阳板保护，一侧温度达370 °C，另一侧为-45 °C。主要发现包括在永久阴影极地陨石坑中存在水冰、之前未知的"洼地"地质特征，以及水星铁核占行星半径约85 %的证实（太阳系行星中核心与半径比最大）。任务于2015-04-30因燃料耗尽以受控撞击的方式在水星表面结束。

en: Apollo 10 flew the entire landing — right up to the last fifteen kilometres — and then, by design, turned around. Stafford and Cernan took the Lunar Module down to within a stone's throw of the surface at Tranquility, ran every step of the descent, and climbed back to orbit without touching down. NASA even left the ascent tanks half-empty, so that however tempting it got, going for it was never an option. It is the least-celebrated flight of the program and one of the most disciplined: a full-speed rehearsal by two men who flew a quarter-million miles knowing the landing belonged to someone else.
cur: Apollo 10 飞完了整个着陆过程——直到最后十五公里——然后按计划掉头返回。斯塔福德和塞尔南驾驶登月舱下降到距 Tranquility 表面近在咫尺的位置,完成了下降的每一步,然后在未着陆的情况下爬升返回轨道。NASA 甚至只给上升级燃料箱加了一半的燃料,这样无论诱惑有多大,真正着陆都不可能成为选项。这是该计划中最少被颂扬的飞行任务,也是最具纪律性的任务之一:两名宇航员进行了一次全速演练,飞行了二十五万英里,却明知着陆的荣誉属于别人。

en: Full lunar-landing dress rehearsal — LM descended to ~15.6 km altitude
cur: 完整的登月预演 — LM 下降至约 15.6 km 高度

en: The full dress rehearsal for the first lunar landing. Stafford and Cernan flew LM Snoopy down to ~15.6 km altitude above the planned Apollo 11 landing site at Mare Tranquillitatis — every step of a landing approach except the actual landing itself. They confirmed the descent profile, the landing radar, the ascent trajectory, and the rendezvous procedure that Apollo 11 would use two months later. The LM's ascent-stage propellant tanks were deliberately underfueled (~50 % of nominal) to prevent any temptation to attempt a landing. Snoopy's ascent stage was the only one to leave lunar orbit with positive ∆v — jettisoned into a heliocentric orbit where it remains today, intermittently re-detected by amateur astronomers (most recently confirmed by Nick Howes / Faulkes Telescope, 2019).
cur: 首次登月的完整预演。斯塔福德和塞尔南驾驶登月舱 Snoopy 下降至距静海上的 Apollo 11 计划着陆点约 15.6 公里的高度——完成了着陆进程的每一步，除了实际着陆本身。他们验证了下降程序、着陆雷达、上升轨迹以及 Apollo 11 两个月后将使用的交会对接程序。登月舱的上升级推进剂箱被刻意减少燃料装载（约为额定值的 50%），以防止任何尝试着陆的想法。Snoopy 的上升级是唯一一个以正向 ∆v 离开月球轨道的上升级——被抛入日心轨道，至今仍存在于其中，间歇性地被业余天文学家重新发现（最近一次由 Nick Howes / Faulkes Telescope 于 2019 年确认）。

en: Apollo 11 was the flight the whole program was built to make — the one that had to work. For eight years and $25 billion, everything NASA did came down, in the end, to getting two people onto this particular patch of grey dust and back off it alive. When Armstrong called "the Eagle has landed," the Cold-War race that opened with a beeping sphere over American cities was effectively over. What's easy to forget now is how little margin there was: the crew came down with seconds of fuel to spare, past a boulder field the maps hadn't shown, riding a guidance computer that was throwing alarms the whole way. It worked anyway — and for one night, a fifth of the species watched the same thing at the same time.
cur: Apollo 11 是这整个航天计划为之而生的飞行任务——这一次非成功不可。八年和 250 亿美元的投入，NASA 所做的一切最终都归结为一点：把两个人送上这片特殊的月球灰尘，再活着带他们回来。当阿姆斯特朗说出"鹰已着陆"时，那场随着一个在美国城市上空发出蜂鸣声的球体而开始的冷战太空竞赛实际上已经结束。现在容易被遗忘的是空间之小：飞船带着仅余几秒的燃料下降，越过地图上从未显示过的巨石区域，依靠一台一路上都在报警的制导计算机。但它成功了——在那一个夜晚，五分之一的人类看着同一件事情发生。

en: The mission that fulfilled Kennedy's 1961 commitment to put a man on the Moon by the end of the decade. Armstrong and Aldrin spent 21 hours 36 minutes on the lunar surface — 2.5 hours of EVA, 21.55 kg of samples, and a single commemorative plaque. The laser retroreflector they installed at Mare Tranquillitatis still receives pulses today, measuring the Earth-Moon distance to millimetre precision. The mission was watched live by ~600 million people, one fifth of humanity at the time.
cur: 这次任务实现了肯尼迪在1961年做出的承诺，即在这个十年末前将人类送上月球。阿姆斯特朗和奥尔德林在月面停留了21小时36分钟——进行了2.5小时的舱外活动，采集了21.55千克的样本，并留下了一块纪念碑。他们在静海安装的激光反射器至今仍在接收地球发出的脉冲，将地月距离的测量精度控制在毫米级。这次任务被约6亿人直播观看，占当时全球人口的五分之一。

en: Second crewed Moon landing — pinpoint touchdown 163 m from Surveyor 3
cur: 第二次载人登月——在距 Surveyor 3 号 163 米处精确着陆

en: The second crewed Moon landing. Saturn V was struck by lightning twice during ascent (T+36 s and T+52 s) — Bean restored the spacecraft via the famous "SCE to AUX" call from EECOM John Aaron, then the crew re-aligned the inertial measurement unit in lunar orbit. Conrad and Bean executed a pinpoint landing on the Ocean of Storms within 163 m of Surveyor 3 (which had soft-landed in April 1967), then walked to Surveyor 3 and removed its camera + sample of its surface — pieces that came home to Earth for analysis of long-term lunar-surface exposure. They deployed ALSEP (the full Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package — the first ALSEP, vs Apollo 11's simpler EASEP) which transmitted data for 8 years. The mission returned 34 kg of samples including dark mare basalts.
cur: 第二次载人登月任务。Saturn V 火箭在上升过程中两次遭雷击（T+36 秒和 T+52 秒）——宾通过 EECOM 约翰·阿伦著名的“SCE to AUX”指令恢复了航天器，随后乘组在月球轨道上重新校准了惯性测量单元。康拉德和宾在风暴洋实现了精确着陆，降落点距 Surveyor 3（该探测器于 1967 年 4 月软着陆）仅 163 米，随后他们步行至 Surveyor 3，取下了它的相机并采集了它的表面样本——这些部件被带回地球，用于分析长期暴露在月表的影响。他们部署了 ALSEP（完整的 Apollo 月面实验包——这是第一套 ALSEP，而 Apollo 11 部署的是更简单的 EASEP），该设备传输数据长达 8 年。任务带回了 34 千克样本，包括暗色月海玄武岩。

en: If Apollo 11 proved you could reach the Moon, Apollo 12 proved you could reach a particular spot on it. Thirty-six seconds after launch, lightning struck the rocket and knocked the spacecraft's instruments offline; a twenty-four-year-old controller named John Aaron pulled an obscure fix — "SCE to AUX" — from memory, and the flight went on. Then Conrad and Bean set their Lunar Module down on the Ocean of Storms a few hundred feet from a probe that had been sitting there for two years, walked over, and brought pieces of it home. That precision was the real result: the Moon had stopped being a destination and become an address.
cur: 如果说Apollo 11证明了你可以到达月球，那么Apollo 12证明了你可以到达月球上的特定地点。发射后三十六秒，闪电击中火箭，导致航天器的仪器离线；一位名叫约翰·阿伦的二十四岁控制员从记忆中想起了一个鲜为人知的解决方案——"SCE to AUX"——飞行任务得以继续。随后，康拉德和宾将他们的月球模块降落在风暴洋，距离一个已经在那里放置了两年的探测器仅有数百英尺的距离，他们走过去，把它的一些部件带了回来。正是这种精准性成为了真正的成果：月球已不再是一个目的地，而成了一个地址。

en: The mission that turned a near-disaster into NASA's most celebrated rescue
cur: 将近乎灾难转化为NASA最著名营救的任务

en: Apollo 13 never landed, and it is the mission everyone remembers. Two days out, an oxygen tank tore itself apart and turned a routine flight to the Fra Mauro highlands into a four-day problem of keeping three men alive in a dying spacecraft a quarter-million miles from home. What saved them was not heroics; it was preparation and a roomful of people working the problem in real time, improvising a way to breathe and a way home out of whatever was already bolted to the vehicle. NASA called it a successful failure. It is closer to the truth to say it is the flight that proved the agency was as good as it claimed to be.
cur: Apollo 13从未登陆月球，却是所有人都记得的任务。在出发两天后，一个氧气罐自行破裂，将一次前往毛罗修士高地的例行飞行变成了一场四天的求生——在一艘破损的宇宙飞船中让三名航天员活着回家，距地球四分之一百万英里。拯救他们的并非英雄般的举动，而是充分的准备和休斯顿任务控制中心一整间屋子的人在实时解决问题、即兴创造呼吸之法和归家之路，用尽一切已经拴在飞行器上的零件。NASA称之为"成功的失败"。更接近事实的说法是，这次飞行证明了该机构确实如其声称的那样卓越。

en: Apollo 13 was meant to be the third crewed lunar landing, targeted at the Fra Mauro highlands. At 55 hours 54 minutes into the flight an oxygen tank in the Service Module ruptured, crippling the Command-Service Module's electrical and life-support systems. With landing scrubbed, the crew — James Lovell, Jack Swigert, and Fred Haise — powered down the CSM, moved into the Lunar Module Aquarius as a lifeboat, and used the LM's descent engine for a Pericynthion+2-hour burn that placed them on a fast free-return trajectory. They swung past the Moon at 254 km altitude on 1970-04-15 and splashed down safely in the South Pacific on 1970-04-17. The mission is studied today as a model of disciplined real-time engineering improvisation.
cur: Apollo 13原定进行第三次载人月球着陆，目标是毛罗修士高地。在飞行的第55小时54分钟，服务舱中的一个氧气罐破裂，导致指令舱-服务舱的电力和生命保障系统瘫痪。登陆计划作废后，宇航员詹姆斯·洛弗尔、杰克·斯威格特和弗莱德·海斯关闭了指令舱，进入登月舱Aquarius作为救生艇，并利用登月舱的下降发动机进行了近月点后+2小时变轨，使其进入快速自由返回轨道。他们在1970年4月15日以254公里的高度掠过月球，并在1970年4月17日安全溅落在南太平洋。这次任务今天被作为有纪律的实时工程即兴创新的典范而被研究。

en: Apollo 14 had to prove the program could still land. It flew nine months after Apollo 13 nearly killed its crew, took over the target Apollo 13 never reached, and put Alan Shepard back in space a decade after he became the first American to leave the planet — grounded in between for years by an inner-ear disorder, and now, at forty-seven, the oldest person to walk on the Moon. He and Mitchell came up about thirty metres short of Cone Crater's rim, unable to tell in the confusing terrain how close they had actually gotten. Then, in the last minutes on the surface, Shepard swung a makeshift six-iron at two golf balls — a stunt, and also a quiet signal that the crisis was behind them and Apollo was flying again.
cur: Apollo 14 必须证明该计划仍然能够着陆。它在 Apollo 13 差点让机组人员丧生的九个月后升空,接管了 Apollo 13 从未抵达的目标,并让艾伦·谢泼德在成为第一位离开地球的美国人十年后重返太空——期间因内耳疾病停飞多年,而现在,47 岁的他成为了在月球上行走的最年长者。他和米切尔在距离锥形撞击坑边缘约 30 米处停下,在令人困惑的地形中无法判断他们实际到达了多近的位置。然后,在月球表面的最后几分钟,谢泼德用临时制作的六号铁杆挥向两颗高尔夫球——这是一次特技表演,也是一个安静的信号,表明危机已经过去,Apollo 又重新飞行了。

en: Third lunar landing — Apollo 13's lost target reached; Shepard's golf shots
cur: 第三次登月 — 抵达Apollo 13号未达成的目标；谢泼德的高尔夫击球

en: The third crewed Moon landing and Alan Shepard's second flight — making him both the first American in space (Freedom 7, 1961) and the fifth man on the Moon, at age 47 the oldest Moonwalker. Apollo 14 was the recovery mission after Apollo 13's aborted landing, taking over Apollo 13's intended Fra Mauro Highlands target. Shepard and Mitchell deployed ALSEP, completed two EVAs totalling 9 h 23 m, and pulled the modular equipment transporter (MET, a rickshaw-style cart — the LRV was still one mission away) toward Cone Crater, though they came up ~30 m short of the rim due to navigation uncertainty in the cratered terrain. In the final minutes of EVA-2, Shepard improvised a six-iron golf-club head onto a sample-collection handle and hit two golf balls "miles and miles and miles" (one was later analysed from imagery at ~24 m and ~37 m). Stuart Roosa carried tree seeds in Kitty Hawk that became the "Moon Trees" planted across the US. 42 kg of samples returned.
cur: 第三次载人月球着陆，也是艾伦·谢泼德的第二次飞行任务——他因此成为既是第一位进入太空的美国人（Freedom 7，1961年）又是第五位登月者的宇航员，47岁时成为最年长的月球漫步者。Apollo 14是在Apollo 13登月任务流产后的恢复任务，接过了Apollo 13原定的毛罗修士高地目标。谢泼德和米切尔部署了ALSEP，完成了两次总计9小时23分钟的舱外活动，并驾驶模块化设备运输车（MET，一种人力车风格的运输工具——月球车还要再等一个任务才能使用）朝向锥形撞击坑行进，但由于陨石坑地形中的导航不确定性，最终距离陨石坑边缘约30米处停下。在舱外活动EVA-2的最后几分钟，谢泼德即兴将一个六号铁杆高尔夫球头安装在样本采集手柄上，打出两颗高尔夫球"几英里又几英里"（其中一颗后来通过影像分析确定距离约24米和37米）。斯图尔特·罗萨在Kitty Hawk上携带了树种，这些种子后来在美国各地种植成为"月球树"。返回样品42千克。

en: First J-mission — extended stay, first Lunar Roving Vehicle, "Genesis Rock"
cur: 首次J型任务——延长停留、首次使用月球车、《创世纪岩石》

en: By Apollo 15 the race was long over, and the science took the wheel — literally. This was the first flight to carry the Lunar Rover, which turned a two-mile walking radius into a proper eighteen-mile field expedition, and it set down not on a safe flat plain but in a valley between a mountain range and a winding canyon. Scott and Irwin came home with the "Genesis Rock," a four-billion-year-old shard of the Moon's original crust that confirmed how it had formed. Apollo had stopped visiting the Moon and started studying it — and it kept getting better at that right up until it was cancelled.
cur: 到Apollo 15时，竞争早已结束，科学接过了方向盘——字面意义上的。这是首次搭载月球车的飞行，它把两英里的步行半径扩大为十八英里的正式野外考察，而且着陆点不是安全平坦的平原，而是山脉与蜿蜒峡谷之间的山谷。斯科特和艾尔文带回了“创世纪岩”，这块四十亿年前的月球原始地壳碎片证实了月壳是如何形成的。Apollo已不再只是造访月球，而是开始研究它——而且直到被取消，它在这方面一直越做越好。

en: The first "J-mission" — extended-stay scientific Apollo with the new Lunar Roving Vehicle. The LRV gave Scott + Irwin a 27.9 km traverse range (vs the 3.5 km of walking-only Apollo 14), opening the dramatic Hadley-Apennine site at the foot of a 4.5-km mountain range and the edge of the sinuous Hadley Rille. Three EVAs totalling 18 h 35 m, 77 kg of samples returned, including the famous "Genesis Rock" (sample 15415) — a 4.1-billion-year-old anorthosite confirming the magma-ocean origin of the lunar highlands crust. Scott's televised "hammer-feather drop" verified Galileo's law of gravitation live. Worden in lunar orbit operated a SIM-bay full of remote-sensing instruments (mapping cameras, gamma-ray, X-ray, alpha-particle spectrometers) and performed the first deep-space EVA on the way home (~39-minute EVA at ~317 000 km from Earth to retrieve the film canisters). Apollo 15's recovery was marred by one of three parachutes failing to deploy — CM splashed down hard but crew was safe.
cur: 首次"J型任务"——配备新型月球车的延长停留科学Apollo任务。月球车使斯科特和艾尔文的活动范围达到27.9 km（相比仅靠步行的Apollo 14的3.5 km），开启了山脚下高达4.5 km山脉和蜿蜒哈德利沟纹附近这一戏剧性的Hadley-Apennine遗迹。共进行三次舱外活动，总计18小时35分钟，带回77 kg样品，其中包括著名的《创世纪岩石》（样品15415）——一块距今41亿年的斜长岩，证实了月球高地地壳源自岩浆洋。斯科特在电视直播中进行的"锤羽毛坠落"实时验证了伽利略的万有引力定律。月球轨道上的Worden操控了装满遥感仪器的SIM舱（测绘相机、伽马射线、X射线、阿尔法粒子分光计），并在返回地球途中执行了首次深空舱外活动（约39分钟，距地球约317 000 km），用以回收胶片筒。Apollo 15的回收任务因三个主降落伞中的一个未能完全展开而受到影响——指挥舱着陆冲击力大，但全体乘员安全。

en: Apollo 16 went to the lunar highlands to sample ancient volcanoes and found there had never been any. Geologists were sure the pale, rugged Descartes region was volcanic; every rock Young and Duke brought back was breccia — rubble welded together by impacts. Being wrong was the payoff: the Moon's bright highlands turned out to be a record of a young solar system under relentless bombardment, not eruption. It is a clean example of how exploration actually earns its keep — you go to confirm what you already think you know, and the place tells you something better.
cur: Apollo 16 前往月球高地采集古代火山样本,却发现那里从未有过任何火山。地质学家们确信苍白崎岖的 Descartes 地区是火山地貌;然而扬和杜克带回的每一块岩石都是角砾岩——由撞击焊接在一起的碎石。错误本身就是收获:月球明亮的高地被证明是年轻太阳系遭受持续轰击而非火山喷发的记录。这是一个清晰的例证,说明探索如何真正证明其价值——你前去确认自己以为已知的事物,而那个地方却告诉你更好的答案。

en: First Moon landing in the lunar highlands — Descartes; John Young's "lunar Grand Prix"
cur: 首次在月球高地登陆 — Descartes；约翰·扬的"月面大奖赛"

en: The fifth crewed Moon landing and the first to a non-mare highland site. Geologists had expected Descartes to be volcanic; Apollo 16 disproved this — every rock returned was breccia (impact-shattered debris), reshaping understanding of the lunar highlands as products of catastrophic impacts rather than ancient volcanism. Young and Duke completed three LRV-supported EVAs totalling 20 h 14 m, traversed 26.7 km, and returned 95.7 kg of samples (the heaviest Apollo haul to that date). Young's "lunar Grand Prix" — a televised speed test of the LRV — peaked at ~17 km/h. Duke's 11-second hop attempt during a long-jump record attempt put him at risk of damaging his PLSS backpack and was called off. Charlie Duke's family photo + the "Far-UV Camera/Spectrograph" — the first astronomical observatory operated from the surface of another world — both ended up at the landing site. Mattingly, originally on Apollo 13 (replaced before launch over German measles concerns), finally got to fly to the Moon.
cur: 第五次载人登月任务，也是首次登陆非月海高地的任务。地质学家曾预期笛卡尔地区具有火山成因；Apollo 16 推翻了这一假设——所有返回的岩石样本都是角砾岩（撞击破碎的碎屑），改变了人们对月球高地是古代火山活动产物的认识，而将其确认为灾难性撞击的结果。扬和杜克完成了三次月球车支持的舱外活动，总计 20 小时 14 分钟，行进 26.7 公里，共采集 95.7 公斤样本（当时 Apollo 任务中最沉重的样本收获）。扬的"月球大奖赛"——月球车的电视直播速度测试——峰值达到约 17 公里/小时。杜克在尝试跳远记录时进行的 11 秒跳跃试验可能会损伤他的 PLSS 背包，因此被叫停。查理·杜克的家庭照片和"Far-UV Camera/Spectrograph"——首个从另一个世界表面操作的天文观测台——都留在了着陆点。Mattingly 原本被分配到 Apollo 13（因德国麻疹隐患在发射前被替换），最终圆梦飞往月球。

en: Apollo 17 was the end, though almost no one watching in December 1972 believed it would be. It was also, belatedly, the flight that put a real scientist on the Moon — the geologist Harrison Schmitt, whose eye caught the orange volcanic glass at Shorty Crater that rewrote what the Moon is made of. Cernan and Schmitt stayed three days, drove twenty-two miles, and then Cernan climbed the ladder for the last time anyone has, saying they left "as we came, and God willing, we shall return." More than half a century later no one has — and every serious argument for going back still begins with the fact that we once could.
cur: Apollo 17 是结束，尽管在 1972 年 12 月观看的几乎没有人相信会是这样。它也延迟地成为了将一位真正的科学家送上月球的飞行——地质学家哈里森·施密特，他的眼睛在矮子撞击坑捕捉到了橙色的火山玻璃，这改写了我们对月球构成的认识。塞尔南和施密特停留了三天，驾驶了二十二英里，随后塞尔南爬上梯子最后一次，说他们"如同来时一样离去，承蒙上帝保佑，我们必将归来"。半个多世纪后没有人回去过——每一个关于回去的严肃论证仍然始于我们曾经能够做到这一点的事实。

en: Last crewed mission to the Moon (and the only Apollo with a trained geologist)
cur: 最后一次载人登月任务（也是唯一配有训练有素的地质学家的Apollo任务）

en: The last time humans visited another world — over half a century ago. Cernan and Schmitt spent 75 hours on the surface, drove the LRV 35.7 km, and brought back 110.5 kg of samples. Schmitt was the only trained scientist (geologist) ever to walk on the Moon, and his findings — particularly the orange volcanic glass at Shorty Crater — reshaped lunar geology. Cernan's last words before climbing the ladder for the final time: 'We leave as we came, and God willing, we shall return.' Artemis III is supposed to make good on that promise.
cur: 人类最后一次访问另一个世界——那已经是半个多世纪前的事了。塞尔南和施密特在月面上度过了75小时，用LRV驾驶了35.7公里，并带回了110.5公斤的样本。施密特是唯一在月球上行走过的受过训练的科学家（地质学家），他的发现——特别是矮子撞击坑的橙色火山玻璃——改变了月球地质学。塞尔南在最后一次爬上梯子前说的最后一句话："我们如同来时一样离开，祈愿上天，我们终将归来。"Artemis III应该会兑现这一诺言。

en: Apollo 8 was a bet placed in a hurry. Intelligence suggested the Soviets might loop a crew around the Moon first, so in the summer of 1968 NASA tore up the flight plan and sent three men to lunar orbit on only the third launch of a rocket that had never carried a crew. It should have been reckless. Instead it became the year's one piece of good news — 1968 had been assassinations, Vietnam, cities on fire — and on Christmas Eve a billion people heard Genesis read from lunar orbit and, in Bill Anders' photograph, watched their whole world rise over a dead horizon for the first time. Apollo 11 is remembered for the Moon. Apollo 8 is the one that showed us the Earth.
cur: Apollo 8是一次仓促下注。情报显示苏联可能会率先派遣载人飞船环绕月球,因此在1968年夏天,NASA撕毁了原定飞行计划,仅在一枚从未载人的火箭进行第三次发射时,就将三名宇航员送往月球轨道。这本应是鲁莽之举,却成为那一年唯一的好消息——1968年充斥着暗杀、越南战争、城市烈火——在平安夜,十亿人听到了从月球轨道传来的《创世记》朗读,并通过比尔·安德斯的照片,第一次看到他们的整个世界从死寂的地平线上升起。人们因登月而铭记Apollo 11,而Apollo 8则是那个让我们看见地球的任务。

en: The first crewed mission to leave low Earth orbit, the first to escape Earth gravity, and the first to orbit the Moon. Launched 1968-12-21 on the first crewed flight of the Saturn V (AS-503), Apollo 8 entered lunar orbit on Christmas Eve 1968. Anders' "Earthrise" photograph during the fourth orbit became one of the most influential images in history. The crew read from Genesis on live television to ~1 billion viewers — the largest TV audience to that date. 10 orbits later they fired the SPS engine for TEI on the far side of the Moon, returning to Pacific splashdown 1968-12-27. NASA had decided in August 1968 to swap Apollo 8's payload from a high-Earth-orbit LM test to a lunar-orbit CSM-only mission after CIA intelligence suggested the USSR might attempt a circumlunar flight first.
cur: 首次载人飞行离开近地轨道、首次逃逸地球引力，以及首次绕月飞行的任务。Apollo 8 于1968年12月21日在Saturn V（AS-503）首次载人飞行中发射，并于1968年平安夜进入月球轨道。宇航员安德斯在第四圈轨道上拍摄的"Earthrise"照片成为历史上最具影响力的图像之一。机组人员在电视直播中诵读《创世纪》，观众约10亿人——这是迄今为止最大的电视观众群体。10圈轨道后，他们在月球远侧点火SPS发动机进行TEI机动，于1968年12月27日返回太平洋溅落区。NASA于1968年8月决定将Apollo 8的载荷从高地轨LM测试改为仅限月球轨道CSM的任务，原因是CIA情报显示苏联可能会率先尝试绕月飞行。

en: First crewed flight beyond low-Earth orbit since Apollo 17 (1972) — and the mission that inspired this project
cur: 自 Apollo 17（1972）以来首次载人飞行超越近地轨道——也是激发本项目灵感的任务

en: The Artemis program's first crewed flight, and the spark that became Orrery. NASA's SLS Block 1 launched an Orion spacecraft with four astronauts — Reid Wiseman (CDR), Victor Glover (PLT), Christina Koch (MS), and CSA's Jeremy Hansen (MS) — onto a hybrid free-return trajectory that swung them around the Moon's far side at roughly 9,200 km altitude and returned them to Earth without any lunar-orbit insertion burn. A 10-day mission ending with Pacific splashdown. Qualified Orion's life-support, navigation, and re-entry systems for crewed flight ahead of the Artemis III surface landing.
cur: Artemis 计划的首次载人飞行，也是激发Orrery诞生的火花。NASA的 SLS Block 1 运载火箭搭载 Orion 航天器，载着四名宇航员——里德·怀斯曼（CDR）、维克多·格洛弗（PLT）、克里斯蒂娜·科克（MS）和加拿大空间局的杰瑞米·汉森（MS）——进入混合自由返回轨道，在月球背面约 9,200 公里的高度飞掠后直接返回地球，无需进行月球轨道捕获减速。这是一次为期 10 天的任务，以太平洋溅落结束。该任务验证了 Orion 航天器的生命保障、导航和再入系统，为即将进行的 Artemis III 月面着陆任务做好了载人飞行准备。

en: First crewed lunar landing since Apollo 17 (1972)
cur: 自 Apollo 17（1972）以来的首次载人月球着陆

en: The first crewed lunar landing in over half a century. Architecture: NASA's SLS Block 1 launches Orion with 4 crew to a Near-Rectilinear Halo Orbit (NRHO) around the Moon. Pre-positioned at NRHO is a SpaceX Starship Human Landing System (HLS), refilled in low-Earth orbit by tankers before its trans-lunar injection. The Orion crew transfers to HLS; 2 astronauts descend to the lunar south pole region for ~6.5 days of surface ops while 2 remain in NRHO. After surface operations, HLS launches back to NRHO for transfer to Orion and Earth return. Will land the first woman and first person of colour on the Moon.
cur: 超过半个世纪以来的首次载人月球着陆。架构：NASA 的 SLS Block 1 火箭将搭载 4 名航天员的 Orion 飞船发射至月球周围的近直线晕轨道（NRHO）。SpaceX Starship 人员着陆系统（HLS）预先配置在 NRHO，在跨月球注入前由加油机在近地轨道进行补给。Orion 航天员转移至 HLS；2 名航天员下降至月球南极地区进行约 6.5 天的月面操作，同时 2 名航天员留在 NRHO。月面操作后，HLS 从 NRHO 发射升空，转移至 Orion 并返回地球。将在月球上着陆首位女性航天员和首位有色人种航天员。

en: First crewed mission to the Lunar Gateway; second crewed lunar landing
cur: 首次前往月球Gateway的载人任务；第二次载人登月

en: Artemis IV is planned as the first crewed mission to visit the Lunar Gateway, NASA's small space station in Near-Rectilinear Halo Orbit (NRHO) around the Moon. It debuts the more powerful SLS Block 1B, whose new Exploration Upper Stage (EUS) lets a single launch carry both Orion with 4 crew and the co-manifested I-HAB (International Habitation) module — built by ESA and JAXA — for delivery to Gateway. After docking Orion and I-HAB to the station, two crew descend to the lunar south pole aboard a SpaceX Starship Human Landing System for the program's second crewed landing, while the others tend the growing Gateway. Planned for ~2028; crew and landing site remain to be assigned.
cur: Artemis IV 计划作为首次造访月球门户的载人任务，月球门户是 NASA 在月球周围近直线晕轨道（NRHO）上的小型空间站。该任务首次使用更强大的 SLS Block 1B，其新型Exploration Upper Stage（EUS）使单次发射能够同时运载搭载 4 名宇航员的Orion以及由 ESA 和 JAXA 建造的共同搭载的I-HAB（International Habitation）模块，并将其送往月球门户。在Orion和I-HAB与空间站对接后，两名宇航员将搭乘SpaceX Starship人类着陆系统降落到月球南极，完成该计划的第二次载人登月，而其他宇航员则照料日益扩建的月球门户。计划于约 2028 年执行；宇航员和着陆地点尚待确定。

en: First privately-funded mission to reach the Moon; first Israeli lunar mission
cur: 首个抵达月球的私人出资任务；以色列首次月球任务

en: SpaceIL's Beresheet (Hebrew: 'In the beginning') launched as a shared-ride passenger on a Falcon 9 in February 2019. Instead of a direct trans-lunar injection, the small lander performed weeks of perigee-raising phasing burns to climb from a parking orbit out to the Moon — a fuel-saving trajectory pioneered for low-budget missions. After successful lunar orbit insertion on 4 April 2019, an inertial measurement unit reset during descent caused the main engine to shut down. Beresheet crashed in Mare Serenitatis. SpaceIL committed to a successor (Beresheet 2) within days.
cur: SpaceIL 的 Beresheet（希伯来文：'In the beginning'）于 2019 年 2 月作为 Falcon 9 火箭的共乘乘客发射升空。这个小型着陆器没有进行直接的月球转移注入，而是进行了数周的近地点提升变轨机动，从停泊轨道爬升到月球——这是为低预算任务开创的燃料节约型轨迹。在 2019 年 4 月 4 日成功进行月球轨道插入后，下降期间惯性测量装置的重置导致主发动机关闭。Beresheet 在风暴洋坠毁。SpaceIL 在数天内承诺实施后续任务（Beresheet 2）。

en: First flight of Blue Origin's Blue Moon lunar lander architecture
cur: Blue Origin Blue Moon 月球着陆器构型的首次飞行

en: Blue Origin's first cargo Blue Moon lander, contracted under NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) program. A single-stage descent vehicle powered by the BE-7 cryogenic engine, designed to deliver up to ~3 tonnes of payload to the lunar surface. Launches on Blue Origin's New Glenn from Cape Canaveral, performs trans-lunar injection on the New Glenn second stage, then executes lunar orbit insertion and powered descent. The Mark 1 cargo flight precedes the human-rated Mark 2, which is contracted to support NASA's Artemis V crewed lunar landing.
cur: Blue Origin 首架货运 Blue Moon 月球着陆器，系根据 NASA 商业月球有效载荷服务（CLPS）计划签约。该单级下降级飞行器由 BE-7 低温发动机驱动，设计用于向月面运送约 3 吨有效载荷。由 Blue Origin 的 New Glenn 火箭从卡纳维拉尔角发射，在 New Glenn 第二级执行月球转移注入，随后进行月球轨道插入和动力下降。Mark 1 货运飞行任务先于人类等级的 Mark 2 进行，Mark 2 已签约支持 NASA 的 Artemis V 载人月球着陆。

en: ISRO's first interplanetary spacecraft. The orbiter delivered the Moon Impact Probe to the lunar surface — the first Indian object on another world — and carried 11 instruments from 6 countries. NASA's Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3) instrument, hosted on Chandrayaan-1, made the discovery that rewrote textbooks: water molecules are widespread across the lunar surface, not just locked in polar shadowed craters. The mission ended abruptly in August 2009 when ISRO lost communication with the spacecraft.
cur: ISRO首个行星际航天器。该轨道器将月球撞击探测器送上月球表面——第一个印度物体抵达另一个天体——并搭载了来自6个国家的11个仪器。NASA的月球矿物绘图仪（M3）搭载在Chandrayaan-1上，这项仪器的发现改写了教科书：水分子广泛分布在月球表面，而不仅仅被锁存在极地阴影陨石坑中。该任务在2009年8月突然结束，当时ISRO失去了与航天器的通信。

en: Following the loss of Chandrayaan-2's Vikram lander in 2019, ISRO's third lunar mission was deliberately conservative — focused on the lander rather than carrying an orbiter. Vikram touched down at 69.4° S latitude, the closest any spacecraft has come to a lunar pole. The Pragyan rover detected sulfur on the lunar surface for the first time and made in-situ thermal measurements. India became the fourth nation to soft-land on the Moon, landing closer to a lunar pole than any spacecraft before it — a region where future water-ice mining may become possible.
cur: 在2019年Chandrayaan-2的维克拉姆(Vikram)着陆器丧失后,印度空间研究组织(ISRO)的第三次月球任务采取了谨慎的设计——专注于着陆器而不搭载轨道器。维克拉姆在69.4°南纬着陆,这是迄今为止任何航天器距离月球两极最近的着陆点。Pragyan月球车首次在月球表面探测到硫,并进行了原位热测量。印度成为第四个实现月球软着陆的国家,着陆点比任何航天器都更接近月球两极——这是一个未来可能进行水冰采矿的地区。

en: China's first lunar mission and first Chinese spacecraft to reach the Moon
cur: 中国首次月球任务，中国首个到达月球的航天器

en: The first phase of China's Lunar Exploration Program (CLEP) and CNSA's first mission beyond Earth. Launched 2007-10-24 from Xichang Satellite Launch Center on a Long March 3A, Chang'e 1 (named after the Moon goddess of Chinese folklore) entered a 200-km circular polar lunar orbit on 2007-11-07. Carried 8 instruments — a CCD stereo camera, a laser altimeter, an imaging spectrometer, gamma-ray and X-ray spectrometers, a microwave radiometer, a solar wind detector, and a high-energy particle detector. Produced China's first full lunar global topographic map at 120-200 m resolution and elemental abundance maps of Th, K, U, O, Si, Mg, Al, Ca, Ti, Fe. Mission deliberately ended 2009-03-01 with a controlled impact at 1.50° S, 52.36° E in Mare Fecunditatis — China's first object on the lunar surface, paving the way for Chang'e 3 (2013 surface landing) and Chang'e 5 (2020 sample return). Operated 16 months — 4 months past nominal.
cur: 中国探月工程（CLEP）的第一阶段，也是中国国家航天局首次赴地球外太空的任务。2007年10月24日从西昌卫星发射中心由长征三号甲运载火箭发射，嫦娥一号（以中国民间传说中的月亮女神嫦娥命名）于2007年11月7日进入距月面200公里的圆形极地轨道。携带8种仪器——CCD立体相机、激光高度计、成像光谱仪、伽马射线和X射线谱仪、微波辐射计、太阳风探测器和高能粒子探测器。生成了中国首幅月球全球地形图，分辨率为120-200米，并绘制了Th、K、U、O、Si、Mg、Al、Ca、Ti、Fe等元素丰度图。任务于2009年3月1日通过有控撞击结束，撞击地点位于丰富海1.50°南、52.36°东——这是中国首个抵达月球表面的物体，为随后的嫦娥三号（2013年月面着陆）和嫦娥五号（2020年样品返回）任务铺平了道路。运行时间为16个月，超过预期任期4个月。

en: First Chinese soft landing on the Moon; deployed Yutu, China's first lunar rover
cur: 中国首次月球软着陆；部署了中国首个月球车玉兔

en: Chang'e 3 was the third lander in CNSA's Chang'e programme and the first successful soft landing on the Moon since the Soviet Luna 24 in 1976 — a 37-year gap. The Long March 3B launched on a direct lunar trajectory in December 2013, with a single mid-course correction before lunar orbit insertion. The lander touched down in Mare Imbrium on 14 December and deployed the Yutu (Jade Rabbit) rover, which operated for 31 months despite a mobility failure ending its drive on lunar day 2. Chang'e 3's lander continued imaging for years afterward.
cur: 嫦娥三号是国家航天局嫦娥项目的第三个着陆器，也是自苏联 Luna 24 在 1976 年着陆以来月球上首次成功的软着陆——间隔 37 年。长征三号B 火箭在 2013 年 12 月以直接月球轨迹发射，在月球轨道插入前进行了一次轨道中期修正。着陆器于 12 月 14 日在雨海着陆，并部署了玉兔月球车。尽管在月球日第 2 天因移动故障而停止行驶，但该月球车运行了 31 个月。嫦娥三号的着陆器在之后的数年里继续进行成像。

en: The lunar far side has no direct radio line of sight to Earth. To land a spacecraft there, China first launched the Queqiao relay satellite to a halo orbit around Earth-Moon Lagrange point L2 — a vantage point that sees both the far side and Earth simultaneously. With that infrastructure in place, Chang'e 4 became the first spacecraft to soft-land on the far side. The Yutu-2 rover has been operating since January 2019 and has driven ~1.6 km as of 2024, making it the longest-operating lunar rover in history.
cur: 月球背面没有到地球的直接无线电视线。为了在那里着陆航天器，中国首先将鹊桥中继卫星送入绕地月系统拉格朗日L2点的晕轨道——一个既能看到背面又能看到地球的有利观测点。有了这一基础设施，嫦娥四号成为第一个在月球背面软着陆的航天器。玉兔二号月球车自2019年1月以来一直在运行，截至2024年已行驶约1.6 km，使其成为历史上运行时间最长的月球车。

en: First lunar sample return in 44 years (since Luna 24, 1976)
cur: 44年来首次月球样品采样返回（自Luna 24，1976年以来）

en: Chang'e 5 was the first sample return from the Moon since the Soviet Union's Luna 24 in 1976 — a 44-year gap. The architecture: orbiter + lander + ascent vehicle + sample-return capsule, all in one launch. The lander touched down at Mons Rümker, drilled and scooped 1.731 kg of regolith, lifted off, rendezvoused and docked with the orbiter (the first robotic lunar rendezvous), and the capsule returned to Earth. The samples are from a region only 2 billion years old — much younger than any Apollo or Luna sample, rewriting models of lunar volcanism.
cur: 嫦娥五号是自苏联Luna 24（1976年）以来首次从月球采样返回——间隔44年。其架构包括：轨道器+着陆器+上升器+样品返回舱，通过单次发射完成。着陆器在吕姆克山着陆，钻探和铲取了1.731千克的月壤，随后升空、与轨道器交会对接（首次月球机器人交会对接），样品返回舱返回地球。这些样品来自一个仅有20亿年历史的区域——远比任何Apollo或Luna样品更年轻，重新改写了月球火山活动模式。

en: Combines the architectures of Chang'e 4 (far-side communications) and Chang'e 5 (sample return). The Queqiao-2 relay satellite was launched first (March 2024) to support the mission. Chang'e 6 then collected 1.935 kg from Apollo Crater on the far side — material with very different composition from any lunar sample previously returned. The Moon's two hemispheres are radically different (the far side has thicker crust, fewer mare); these samples may finally explain why.
cur: 结合了嫦娥四号（远端通信）和嫦娥五号（样本返回）的架构。鹊桥二号中继卫星首先于2024年3月发射，为该任务提供支持。嫦娥六号随后从月球背面的阿波罗环形山采集了1.935千克样本——这些物质的成分与之前返回的任何月球样本都明显不同。月球的两个半球差异巨大（背面地壳更厚，月海较少）；这些样本或许终于能解释这一原因。

en: Joint NASA-DoD lunar mission; first hints of water ice at lunar poles
cur: NASA-DoD 联合月球任务；首次在月球极地发现水冰迹象

en: Designed primarily as a Strategic Defense Initiative technology demonstrator, Clementine spent 10 weeks in lunar orbit returning the first systematic global topographic and multispectral map of the Moon. Bistatic radar measurements at the lunar south pole produced the first tantalising hints of water ice — confirmed years later by Lunar Prospector and Chandrayaan-1. The follow-on mission to flyby the asteroid Geographos failed when a thruster malfunction depleted the spacecraft's propellant.
cur: Clementine 的主要设计目的是作为战略防御计划技术演示器，它在月球轨道运行 10 周，首次返回了月球系统性的全球地形图和多光谱图。在月球南极进行的双站雷达测量首次产生了水冰的迹象，这一发现后来得到 Lunar Prospector 和 Chandrayaan-1 的证实。后续的飞掠小行星地理星任务因推进器故障导致航天器燃料耗尽而失败。

en: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
cur: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter

en: Orbiting the Moon since 2009 at 50 km mean lunar altitude, LRO's narrow-angle camera images at 50 cm/pixel — high enough to see Apollo descent stages, rover tracks, and astronaut footpaths still preserved in the regolith. It found Lunokhod 1 thirty-nine years after the rover went dark. It identified 200+ candidate landing sites for Artemis. The water ice deposits at the lunar south pole that drive every modern lunar programme were quantified by LRO instruments. A scout mission that became the foundation of the modern lunar era.
cur: 自2009年以来环绕月球，轨道高度为月球平均半径50 km，LRO的窄角相机以50 cm/像素的分辨率成像——足以拍摄到仍然保存在月壤中的Apollo着陆段、月球车轨迹和宇航员足迹。它在月球车停止工作三十九年后发现了Lunokhod 1。它为Artemis任务确定了200多个候选着陆点。驱动每一个现代月球项目的月球南极水冰沉积物由LRO仪器量化测定。一个作为现代月球时代基础的侦察任务。

en: First spacecraft to orbit the Moon (and any body other than Earth)
cur: 第一个绕月球运行的航天器（以及除地球外任何天体的首颗人造卫星）

en: Launched 1966-03-31 from Baikonur, Luna 10 became the first spacecraft to orbit the Moon — and the first artificial satellite of any body other than Earth — when it inserted into a 350 × 1017 km lunar orbit at 71.9° inclination on 1966-04-03. Two and a half years before Apollo 8 reached the Moon with humans aboard. Carried a magnetometer, gamma-ray spectrometer, infrared radiometer, micrometeoroid detectors, plasma sensors, and a radio probe of the lunar gravity field. The gamma-ray data was the first compositional remote sensing of the Moon, suggesting basalt-like mare composition. Famously broadcast the Internationale anthem during the 23rd Congress of the Soviet Communist Party on 1966-04-04 — a propaganda flourish more than science. Operated 56 days / 460 orbits before its NiCd batteries depleted on 1966-05-30; remains in lunar orbit.
cur: Luna 10 于 1966-03-31 从拜科努尔发射升空。1966-04-03，它进入倾角为 71.9° 的月球轨道（350 × 1017 km），成为第一个绕月球运行的航天器，也是第一颗除地球外任何天体的人造卫星——比Apollo 8号载人登月早了两年半。搭载磁强计、伽马射线分光计、红外辐射计、微陨石探测器、等离子体传感器和月球重力场无线电探针。伽马射线数据是月球成分的首次遥感探测，表明月海具有玄武岩质成分。1966-04-04 在苏联共产党第 23 次代表大会期间播放了《国际歌》——这更多是宣传噱头而非科学壮举。任务运行 56 天、环绕 460 圈，至 1966-05-30 NiCd电池耗尽后结束；仍留轨于月球轨道。
